record.question: What does the Unorganised Workers Social Security Act, 2008 define as an unorganised worker?
options: Only a wage worker in the unorganised sector.
An employed worker in the organised sector.
A worker with more than 10 years of experience.
An employed worker, contract worker, casual and bonded labor, or a wage worker in the unorganised sector.
